April 18, 2018 - By Peter Erickson 
John Thiessen increased its stake in Noble Corp Plc (NE) by 16.63% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Vertex One Asset Management Inc bought 365,980 shares as the company’s stock declined 13.24% with the market. The hedge fund run by John Thiessen held 2.57 million shares of the oil & gas production company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $11.60 million, up from 2.20 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Vertex One Asset Management Inc who had been investing in Noble Corp Plc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $1.18B market cap company. The stock increased 4.84% or $0.22   $4.77.
